    """Find rectangular boxes; the box whose interior holds a pattern is the
    source. Every other box whose interior is exactly the same size as the
    source pattern gets that pattern recolored to the box's color; all other
    boxes are erased entirely."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bs = []
    for c in range(1, 10):
        pts = [(i, j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j] == c]

            continue
        i0 = min(p[0] for p in pts); i1 = max(p[0] for p in pts)

    for b in bs:

        inn = [row[j0+1:j1] for row in grid[i0+1:i1]]
        if any(v != 0 for r in inn for v in r):

    for b in bs:

                    out[i][j] = grid[i][j]

'''
